checks.title: Orders list loads with default filters, columns, and backing API call

applicability.state: orders list, default filters

checks.precondition: Log in to portal as owner (verify sub=273 per account-scope note) and open the Orders list.
steps: Open portal/orders.
Observe the default date range, Store filter, TIB Status filter, and grid columns.
Observe the backing network call.
checks.observation_point: Default filter values; grid column set; GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1 query parameters.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: date range 'Aug 14 - Sep 13' (relative to run date), Store 'Any', TIB Status 'Any'; columns checkbox/Order/Domain/Store ID/Date/Total/TIB Status/Store Status/Action; backed by GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1&cursor=&per_page=25&sort=created_at&sort_type=desc. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Orders list search matches by internal order name

applicability.state: orders list, search box used

checks.precondition: At least one order (e.g. '#1002') exists in the list.
steps: Type the internal order name (e.g. '#1002') into the search box.
Observe the filtered result.
checks.observation_point: Whether the matching order row appears.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: searching by internal order 'name' (e.g. '#1002') returns the matching order. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Orders list search does NOT match the Shopify checkout confirmation code, even for a synced order

applicability.state: orders list, search box used with Shopify confirmation code

checks.precondition: A synced order exists whose Shopify checkout confirmation code (e.g. 'JTEL87JY0'-style) is known.
steps: Type the Shopify checkout confirmation code into the orders-list search box.
Observe the result.
checks.observation_point: Whether any row is returned.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: no result is returned for the Shopify confirmation code, even though the order is synced and searchable by its internal name — these are separate identifier namespaces in this system. This is a documented current-behavior limitation, not confirmed to be a bug; deviation (either direction) should be investigated rather than assumed.

checks.title: Order-details header shows correct naming format, status badge, and timezone rendering

applicability.state: order #1002 (id 4322), tib_status=ready

checks.precondition: Open the order-details page for a synced order.
steps: Open order-details for the order.
Observe the header: name/id format, TIB status badge, created timestamp and its rendered timezone.
checks.observation_point: Header text format; badge label; timestamp value and timezone.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: header shows '#<name> (#-<id>)' format, TIB status badge (e.g. 'ready'), created timestamp rendered in America/New_York regardless of the buyer's checkout timezone (UTC). Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Order Items section displays full field set for a single line item

applicability.state: order #1002, single order item

checks.precondition: Open order-details for an order with exactly one line item.
steps: Locate the order-item card in order-details.

Observe item-level status badge, campaign/variant links, Shopify SKU vs Fulfilled SKU, POD service, Shopify fulfillment status, fulfillment service, Customization block, and Designs data (mockup, artwork name, printarea, pixel size).
checks.observation_point: Presence and values of each field listed above.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: item shows its OWN status badge (independent of the order-level badge), campaign/variant links, distinct Shopify SKU vs Fulfilled SKU, a POD service (e.g. Printify), empty Shopify fulfillment status, fulfillment service 'manual', a Customization block (View/Edit), and Designs data including a printarea with pixel dimensions noticeably higher-resolution than the on-screen mockup preview. This is observed on exactly ONE line item — do not assume the same layout holds for multi-item orders. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Portal UI tib_status badge is consistent with the API tib_status integer value

applicability.state: order #1002, tib_status=ready/6

checks.precondition: Order visible in both portal UI and reachable via GET /api/orders.
steps: Read the tib_status badge label shown in the portal UI for the order.
Query GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1 for the same order and read its tib_status integer field.
Compare the two.
checks.observation_point: UI badge label vs. API integer value for the same order at the same time.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: UI badge 'ready' corresponds to API tib_status integer 6. This is the ONLY label<->integer pairing ever observed in this run — do not assume other labels/values follow a predictable pattern. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Item Activity Logs shows the automatic post-creation event sequence

applicability.state: order-item, right after order creation

checks.precondition: Open an order-item's 'Item Activity Logs' dialog shortly after order creation.
steps: Open the Item Activity Logs dialog for the order-item.
Observe the sequence and timing of logged events.
checks.observation_point: Event sequence, timestamps, and identifiers (printarea/artwork/artwork-version) in the log.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: 4 automatic events fire within ~22 seconds of order creation with no manual merchant action: line item created -> generating a design -> design generated (with printarea/artwork/artwork-version identifiers) -> marked 'Ready to fulfill'. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Fulfillment Shipping method panel shows its default (unconfigured) state correctly, separate from the Shopify checkout shipping method

applicability.state: order #1002, no fulfillment shipping method configured

checks.precondition: Open order-details for an order where no fulfillment shipping method has been set.
steps: Locate the 'Fulfillment Shipping method' panel.
Observe its displayed state and affordances.
checks.observation_point: Panel text, Edit affordance, and whether it differs from the Shopify checkout shipping method shown elsewhere.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: panel shows 'No shipping method' with an 'Edit' button and a 'Set up shipping method' link; this is a separate order/instance-level configuration from the Shopify checkout shipping choice ('Standard' $8.00 in the source order). Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Notes/Customer/Shipping/Billing panels mirror the data entered at storefront checkout

applicability.state: order-details view

checks.precondition: Open order-details for a synced order whose storefront checkout data is known.
steps: Compare Notes/Customer/Shipping/Billing panel contents in order-details against the data entered at Shopify checkout for the same order.
checks.observation_point: Field-by-field match between checkout-entered data and portal-displayed data.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: Notes shows 'No notes from customer' (when none given), Customer/Shipping/Billing panels correctly mirror the name/email/address entered at checkout, with an 'Edit' affordance on Customer. Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: 'Confirm & Send to fulfill' opens a read-only review dialog with no mutation, when POD (Printify) is NOT connected

applicability.state: order #1002, tib_status=ready, POD (Printify) NOT connected on this instance

checks.precondition: Instance has no Printify (or other POD) account connected.
steps: Open order-details for a ready order.
Click 'Confirm & Send to fulfill'.
Observe the resulting dialog and capture network calls fired around the click.
checks.observation_point: Dialog content/actions available; network calls (mutation vs. read-only query) fired around the click.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state, STRICTLY SCOPED TO THE POD-DISCONNECTED STATE: a review dialog opens (not an immediate submission), showing line item/printareas/status/shipping address, with a 'Close' action and a 'Connect' prompt for Printify — no submit/pay action available. Only 2 read-only GraphQL re-fetches (orders_by_pk, order_item_activities) are observed; no mutation and no outbound call to a POD provider occurs. This finding does NOT apply to the POD-connected state — see CHK-P16 for that branch, which is unconfirmed.

checks.title: 'Change status' dropdown displays exactly the 5 expected option labels

applicability.state: order-item, 'Change status' dropdown opened, no option selected

checks.precondition: Open order-details for an order-item and locate the 'Change status' control.
steps: Open the 'Change status' dropdown for the order-item.
Observe the list of options shown.
Close the dropdown WITHOUT selecting any option.
checks.observation_point: Exact set and order of option labels shown in the dropdown.
checks.expected_result: Baseline observed state: the dropdown lists exactly 5 options: Ready, Sent, Fulfilled, Paused, Canceled. This check covers ONLY the displayed option list — it does NOT cover selecting any option, since no transition, endpoint, or side effect has ever been observed for this control (see CHK-P10 vs. this: transitions are out of scope here by design). Deviation = investigate, not an automatic bug.

checks.title: Merchant-facing signal (or lack thereof) when an order fails to sync from storefront checkout into the portal

applicability.state: an order was completed at storefront checkout but does not (yet) appear in the portal Orders list

checks.precondition: A storefront checkout completes while the sync issue described in OQ-order-001 is reproduced (order not yet visible in portal).
steps: After confirming a storefront order that has not yet appeared in the portal, check the portal for any error banner, notification, count discrepancy, or other merchant-facing signal indicating a missing/pending order.
Record whether any such signal exists.
checks.observation_point: Presence/absence of any UI signal in the portal indicating a sync problem or pending order.
checks.expected_result: Not established — this run never observed any merchant-facing error/notification for the missing order (JTEL87JY0); the portal simply showed nothing where the order should have been. Whether that silence is itself expected/acceptable, or a gap that should surface an alert, has never been confirmed by PO/Dev.

checks.title: Non-owner / restricted-permission portal role access to orders list, order-details, fulfill action, and change-status dropdown

applicability.state: same orders/order-details as tested for owner

checks.precondition: A non-owner or restricted-permission portal account exists.
steps: Log in as a non-owner/restricted role.
Attempt to view the orders list, order-details, 'Confirm & Send to fulfill', and 'Change status' dropdown.
Compare against the owner (sub=273) baseline.
checks.observation_point: Whether access, visibility, or available actions differ from the owner role.
checks.expected_result: Not established — only the owner role (sub=273) was exercised against every capability in this feature in this run; no access boundary is known.

checks.title: Order/order-item database rows match what the portal UI and API display

applicability.state: order / order-item DB rows for a synced order

checks.precondition: DB observation/access enabled for the target instance (was disabled for this run).
steps: Query the order and order-item rows for a known synced order directly from the database.
Compare field values against what the portal UI and REST/GraphQL API show for the same order.
checks.observation_point: Field-by-field match between DB row values and UI/API-displayed values.
checks.expected_result: Not established — database observation was disabled for this entire bootstrap; no DB-layer evidence exists anywhere in this knowledge base.

checks.title: 'Edit customization' / 'View customization' effect on the design/order state

applicability.state: order-item Customization block

checks.precondition: Open an order-item's Customization block.
steps: Click 'View customization' and observe what is shown.
Click 'Edit customization' (if safe/reversible) and observe available actions and any resulting state change.
checks.observation_point: Content shown by View; available actions and any design/order/regeneration effect triggered by Edit.
checks.expected_result: Not established — neither action was ever exercised in this run.

checks.title: 'Confirm & Send to fulfill' behavior when a POD account (e.g. Printify) IS connected

applicability.state: order ready, POD (Printify) account CONNECTED on this instance

checks.precondition: An instance with a real POD (e.g. Printify) account connected.
steps: Open order-details for a ready order on a POD-connected instance.
Click 'Confirm & Send to fulfill'.
Capture all network calls fired around the click before deciding whether to proceed further.
checks.observation_point: Whether any mutation fires; whether any outbound call to the POD provider occurs; whether a real fulfillment/purchase order is created.
checks.expected_result: Not established — completely unknown. KB-022's 'no mutation, no POD call' finding is scoped STRICTLY to the POD-disconnected state (see CHK-P10) and must NOT be assumed to also hold here. This branch may have a real, potentially costly production side effect and has never been observed.
